_README: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO PARAMETERS. Every rule, threshold and cutoff in this file exists so the offline demo can run; none is a recommendation and none was tuned against real outcomes. Your deployment's scoring config is decided at provisioning (provision-gtm-engine Phase 1) and named by SCORING_CONFIG_FILE in instance-config.json. Values traceable to the repo are listed under _sources; everything else is a demo parameter.

_sources.exclusions.max_gtm_team: gtm-signal-scan SKILL.md Step 2: exclude a GTM engineering team of 2+ (hiring) or a sales/RevOps team of 4+ (funding).

_sources.people.good_tier_max: gtm-signal-scan Step 4: Good tier picks 1-2 regardless.
_sources.people.role_priority: gtm-signal-scan Step 4 selection priority. The weights are demo parameters.
_sources.people.skip_terms: gtm-signal-scan Step 4: skip advisors, investors, board members, engineers, recruiters.
